 GTA 6 Has 62 Bird Types, Confirms Rockstar Games
 Most people struggle to name more than 20 or 30 bird species. So, of course, Rockstar has gone overboard and thrown in 62 types of birds into GTA 6. They will add to the game’s incredible density, but make game completion that much harder.
 It would be very unRockstarlike to skimp on the details and granularity of GTA 6 ‘s world. It’s no surprise to hear then that Grand Theft Auto 6 has more bird types littered throughout the game than America has states—much more.
 Also, you can buy Grand Theft Auto 6 here , if you haven’t already!
 Rockstar Games Reveals 62 Different Types of Birds in GTA 6
 Credit to Rockstar Games 
 In one of the final major previews before GTA 6’s launch, The Guardian described its experience of the game, how they interacted with the world, and explained their brief curiosity about a bird.
 More Insider Gaming: How Much Money Has GTA 6 Made in Pre-Orders? 
 Here’s what The Guardian said:
 ‘Later, I see a gull sitting on a post by the beach and ask, just to be annoying, what kind of bird it is. Jason pulls out a pair of binoculars, the gull is recorded in a wildlife logbook, and I am told with pride that there are 62 types of birds to spot.’
 As we’ve already covered in our piece on how long it will take to complete GTA 6 and get the Platinum Trophy Mythic Achievement , we mentioned that it’s likely you’ll need to track down all birds—although it’s not official.
 More Insider Gaming: How to Play GTA 6 Early on PS5 With New Zealand Trick 
 62 birds, and you just know a handful of them are super-rare and will be much harder to track down than a common bread-eating seagull!
